g.text: A run only counts when it closes
Two of the three paths out of the gate are finished work. Only the third is allowed to change the rig.
the scope the next run is handed
which agent gets that kind of work
which tools it may reach at all
a closed run seeds the next one
the same failure is paid for once
Green = the work path · blue = closing the run · red = the failure path · dashed purple = the only edits the loop makes to itself
